summary: A planned 300 mm CMOS logic fab in the Dholera Special Investment Region, Gujarat, first announced in September 2022 as part of a Vedanta–Foxconn semiconductor and display project put at USD 20 billion, or about INR 1.54 lakh crore, with Vedanta holding 60 percent. The site at Dholera was chosen in February 2023. Foxconn withdrew from the joint venture in July 2023 and Vedanta Limited took full ownership; the national incentive body turned down the original 2022 application, and Vedanta said it would start construction once its new application under the modified scheme was approved. Vedanta describes a fab of 40,000 wafer starts a month, starting on 40nm and moving to 28nm, but no approval, technology partner or construction has been reported.

location.note: In Ahmedabad district, roughly 100 km from Ahmedabad.

metrics.note: Covers the semiconductor fab, a display fab and an assembly and test unit together.
INR 1.54 lakh crore under the September 2022 agreements with Gujarat, covering both the semiconductor and the display plants.
300 mm wafer starts a month as described on Vedanta's undated business page.
Jobs potential claimed for the whole semiconductor and display project.

notes: The record covers the semiconductor fab only; the display fab announced with it is out of scope. Foxconn's exit is not a cancellation by the operator: Vedanta kept the project company and still describes the fab on its business page (s6), which is undated, so the status date is taken from Vedanta's July 2023 statements (s5, s7). In July 2023 Vedanta said the state had allotted the land and site preparation was under way, but that building would wait for national approval. No source from 2024 to 2026 reporting an approval, construction, a new technology partner or a withdrawal could be found. The Tata Electronics fab at Dholera (tata-electronics-dholera-fab) is a separate project.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Added a July 2023 PTI report that the India Semiconductor Mission had not approved the 2022 application and that a new one was under consideration, with the mission as a party, and moved the status date to it; noted Vedanta's statement that site preparation had begun.
